topNews.text: It’s a Record Breeding Year for National Bird of Serbia: The Eastern Imperial Eagle
topNews.excerpt: Protection and conservation programs have recorded a banner year for the eastern imperial eagle, as majestic a bird as you’re likely to see in Europe, and the national bird of Serbia. Emblazoned on the flag of the Balkans nation, 29 breeding pairs were counted out of which 16 helped 25 chicks to hatch and fledge.
topNews.creator: Andy Corbley
